title: Christmas Gift for Grandson: A Story Album | Albums.ink
desc: A Christmas gift for your grandson that lasts: a story album of your years together with photos, videos and your own voice. Free in the browser.
h1: A Christmas gift for your grandson he will keep
lead: Canadian searches for “christmas gift for grandson” quickly split into “newborn”, “teenage” and “adult grandson”. Toys and gift cards change with every age; what stays interesting is the story of your time together. A story album with photos, videos and your voice works for a baby, a teen or a grandson who has moved out.
body: ## Why an album works at any age
- Newborn grandson: his first Christmas, the visit to the hospital, your first photo together – he will read it later.
- Teenage grandson: hockey games, the cottage, the summer you taught him to fish.
- Adult grandson: old family photos he has never seen, with you explaining who is who.
## What to put inside
- Photos of the two of you, year by year.
- Scanned prints of his parents as kids – grandsons love those.
- A short video from the rink, the lake or the kitchen.
- A voice note: a story only you can tell.
## Chapter ideas
1. The day you were born.
2. Winters together.
3. Summers at the lake.
4. What I hope for you.
## How to make it (free)

On Albums you build a story album from photos, videos and voice notes, split into chapters, with voice narration if you like. Albums are unlimited and stay as long as you want them. Free photos are stored at up to 2048 px on the long edge.
1. Sign in with Google and create an album, e.g. “For Liam – Christmas 2026”.
2. Add photos and videos chapter by chapter and write a few lines for each.
3. Record a voice note right in the browser.
4. You can invite one co-author, e.g. Grandpa or Grandma; they must be on your friends list on Albums.

5. Choose visibility: Public, Friends or Only me. New albums are public, so set it to Only me until Christmas. If someone is helping, don’t leave it on Only me – co-authors lose access. Use Friends except… to hide it from your grandson until the big day.
!cta
## Giving it on Christmas morning

Watch it together on a tablet, or change the visibility and text him the link. A public album opens in the browser with a cover preview, nothing to install. Friends only shows it to signed-in friends. An album set to Only me cannot be opened by link. You can download the whole album as one ZIP file.
## A note on privacy
Share photos of children only as far as his parents are comfortable with. Single files can be hidden from specific people.

faq: What is a meaningful Christmas gift for a grandson?
Something personal: a shared memory, family photos or an album that tells the story of your time together in your own voice.
Yes. Story albums are free and unlimited.
Does my grandson need an account?
Not for a public album – the link opens in the browser.
Can I add to it next year?
Yes. Add a new chapter every year.
